Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, RET-001. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: confirmed.

A task explicitly names a tracked extensionless path (Dockerfile, Makefile) or dot-prefixed path (.gitignore, .github/workflows/ci.yml). contextPathTokens discards the token before tracked-path resolution. Named files lose the mentioned relation, can disappear entirely, do not contribute path anchors to span sufficiency, and cannot rescue unsupported-name abstention. Lexical fallback sometimes hides the omission but changes authority/confidence and priority.
